pairs.why: The two pianos are nearly identical, but B's wood panels read a little smoother and less grainy, which the lessons say is closer to the real cards' soft, painted finish.
Same build in both, but A's mahogany shows more busy grain streaks while B's surfaces are slightly cleaner and softer, closer to the guitar, gate and clock finish.
Both pianos have the same shape, gloss, lighting and wood finish, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.
The pianos are almost identical, but B's wallpaper damask and reflections are a bit busier, so A reads marginally calmer and closer to the real cards' simple backgrounds.
